-- =====================================================================
-- Ava Booking Assistant - Postgres schema (v1)
-- One schema per stack ("ava"). All times are timestamptz (stored UTC).
-- Safe to re-run: everything uses IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT.
-- =====================================================================

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ava;
SET search_path TO ava, public;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Settings: every preference lives here, never in workflow JSON
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS settings (
  key         text PRIMARY KEY,
  value       jsonb NOT NULL,
  description text,
  updated_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

INSERT INTO settings (key, value, description) VALUES
  ('persona_name',            '"Ava"',                         'Assistant name shown to clients'),
  ('owner_name',              '"Rob"',                         'Name Ava uses for the owner'),
  ('timezone',                '"America/New_York"',            'IANA timezone for hours and display'),
  ('work_days',               '[1,2,3,4,5]',                   'ISO weekdays bookable (1=Mon)'),
  ('work_start',              '"09:00"',                       'Bookable window start (local)'),
  ('work_end',                '"17:00"',                       'Bookable window end (local)'),
  ('buffer_minutes',          '15',                            'Padding before and after each call'),
  ('min_notice_hours',        '4',                             'Earliest bookable time from now'),
  ('max_days_out',            '30',                            'Furthest bookable day'),
  ('quiet_start',             '"18:00"',                       'Quiet hours start (local, weeknights)'),
  ('quiet_end',               '"08:00"',                       'Quiet hours end (local)'),
  ('quiet_weekends',          'true',                          'Fri quiet_start to Mon quiet_end is quiet'),
  ('approval_timers',         '{"standard":{"checkpoint":120,"expire":240},"urgent":{"checkpoint":60,"expire":120}}',
                                                               'Active minutes until checkpoint and expiry'),
  ('urgent_days',             '7',                             'Calls within N days of request are urgent'),
  ('urgent_keywords',         '["asap","urgent"]',             'Words that mark a request urgent'),
  ('takeover_resume_hours',   '24',                            'Ava resumes after owner silence'),
  ('change_cutoff_hours',     '24',                            'No AI reschedules/cancels inside this window'),
  ('reminder_minutes',        '[1440,60]',                     'Client reminders before a call'),
  ('spam_block',              '{"count":3,"days":30}',         'Block after N spam messages in D days'),
  ('owner_chat_id',           '"5076593768"',                  'Owner Telegram chat for alerts'),
  ('ops_chat_id',             '"5076593768"',                  'Managed-service ops alerts (errors)'),
  ('calendar_id',             '"automatestpete@gmail.com"',    'Google Calendar to book into'),
  ('model_tier',              '"standard"',                    'Client agent tier: economy|standard|premium'),
  ('models',                  '{"classifier":"openai/gpt-oss-120b","economy":"openai/gpt-oss-120b","standard":"openai/gpt-4.1-mini","premium":"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"}',
                                                               'OpenRouter model per tier (set at build)')
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Services
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS services (
  id           serial PRIMARY KEY,
  name         text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  duration_min int  NOT NULL CHECK (duration_min IN (30, 60)),
  audience     text NOT NULL CHECK (audience IN ('new','existing','both')),
  description  text,
  active       boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  sort_order   int NOT NULL DEFAULT 100
);

INSERT INTO services (name, duration_min, audience, description, sort_order) VALUES
  ('Consultation',                        60, 'new',      'General consultation on a technical need', 10),
  ('Project scoping',                     60, 'new',      'Define scope, deliverables and estimate for a project', 20),
  ('Troubleshooting',                     60, 'both',     'Diagnose and fix a broken system or workflow', 30),
  ('Automation opportunity assessment',   60, 'new',      'Map manual processes to automation wins', 40),
  ('n8n health check or audit',           60, 'both',     'Errors, performance, credentials and scaling review', 50),
  ('Self-hosting architecture review',    60, 'both',     'Docker, Coolify, Postgres, Caddy, Tailscale setups', 60),
  ('AI agent and RAG design session',     60, 'both',     'Design AI agents and retrieval pipelines', 70),
  ('n8n scaling setup',                   60, 'both',     'Queue mode, workers, environments', 80),
  ('Training or handoff session',         60, 'existing', 'Teach the team to own what was built', 90),
  ('Project update',                      30, 'existing', 'Status update on an active project', 100),
  ('Alignment meeting',                   30, 'existing', 'Align on priorities and next steps', 110),
  ('Quick question or office hours',      30, 'both',     'One focused problem', 120),
  ('Single workflow review',              30, 'both',     'Review one workflow', 130),
  ('Stack recommendation',                30, 'new',      'Which tool to use for a given job', 140)
ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING;

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. Clients and their channel identifiers
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clients (
  id              uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name            text,
  email           text,
  phone           text,
  company         text,
  is_existing     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,   -- true = fast path
  found_via       text,
  notes           text,
  takeover_until  timestamptz,                      -- Ava silent until this time
  created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_identifiers (
  id          bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  client_id   uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  channel     text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('telegram','email','phone','instagram','facebook','whatsapp','form')),
  identifier  text NOT NULL,                        -- chat id, lowercased email, E.164 phone...
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (channel, identifier)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS client_identifiers_client_idx ON client_identifiers(client_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. Bookings (requests, reschedules, cancellations) - the state machine
--    pending -> approved | declined | expired ; approved -> cancelled | completed
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookings (
  id                   uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  client_id            uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id),
  service_id           int REFERENCES services(id),
  kind                 text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (kind IN ('new','reschedule')),
  replaces_booking_id  uuid REFERENCES bookings(id),   -- reschedule: the original call
  status               text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                         CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','declined','expired','cancelled','completed')),
  start_at             timestamptz NOT NULL,
  end_at               timestamptz NOT NULL,
  call_format          text NOT NULL CHECK (call_format IN ('meet','phone')),
  call_phone           text,
  topic                text,                          -- what they need help with
  budget_text          text,
  timeline_text        text,
  notes                text,
  channel              text NOT NULL,                 -- channel to reply on
  urgent               boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  urgent_reason        text,
  requested_at         timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  checkpoint_due_at    timestamptz,                   -- computed in active (non-quiet) minutes
  checkpoint_sent_at   timestamptz,
  expires_at           timestamptz,
  decided_at           timestamptz,
  calendar_event_id    text,
  meet_link            text,
  approval_message_id  bigint,                        -- Telegram message holding the buttons
  reminder_24h_sent_at timestamptz,
  reminder_1h_sent_at  timestamptz,
  created_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CHECK (end_at > start_at)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bookings_status_idx ON bookings(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bookings_client_idx ON bookings(client_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS bookings_start_idx  ON bookings(start_at) WHERE status = 'approved';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. Message log (every inbound and outbound message, every channel)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
  id           bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  client_id    uuid REFERENCES clients(id),
  channel      text NOT NULL,
  direction    text NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('in','out')),
  author       text NOT NULL CHECK (author IN ('client','ava','owner','system')),
  sender_ref   text,                                 -- raw identifier (chat id / email)
  external_id  text,                                 -- Telegram message id / Gmail id
  thread_ref   text,                                 -- Gmail thread id
  category     text,                                 -- inquiry, existing_client, spam, ...
  body         text,
  meta         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_client_idx ON messages(client_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_sender_idx ON messages(channel, sender_ref);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. Owner alerts (queue - held during quiet hours unless urgent)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS owner_alerts (
  id                   bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  kind                 text NOT NULL,                -- approval, reminder, expiry, client_msg, spam,
                                                     -- email_notice, email_personal, cancel, error...
  urgent               boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  text                 text NOT NULL,
  buttons              jsonb,                        -- Telegram inline keyboard
  booking_id           uuid REFERENCES bookings(id),
  ref                  jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,  -- gmail id, spam event id, ...
  status               text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ('queued','sent','failed','void')),
  deliver_after        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  sent_at              timestamptz,
  telegram_message_id  bigint,
  created_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS owner_alerts_due_idx ON owner_alerts(deliver_after) WHERE status = 'queued';

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. Spam events and the derived blocklist
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS spam_events (
  id          bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  channel     text NOT NULL,
  identifier  text NOT NULL,
  message_id  bigint REFERENCES messages(id),
  action      text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                CHECK (action IN ('pending','brushed_off','ignored','not_spam')),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS spam_events_sender_idx ON spam_events(channel, identifier, created_at);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. AI usage (for pass-through billing)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage (
  id                bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  workflow          text NOT NULL,
  model             text NOT NULL,
  tier              text,
  prompt_tokens     int,
  completion_tokens int,
  cost_usd          numeric(12,6),
  client_id         uuid REFERENCES clients(id),
  created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- =====================================================================
-- Helper functions
-- =====================================================================

-- Setting accessor: ava.setting('timezone') ->> text
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION setting(k text) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$ SELECT value FROM ava.settings WHERE key = k $$;

-- Is a moment inside quiet hours?
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_quiet(ts timestamptz DEFAULT now()) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
  tz      text    := ava.setting('timezone') #>> '{}';
  q_start time    := (ava.setting('quiet_start') #>> '{}')::time;
  q_end   time    := (ava.setting('quiet_end')   #>> '{}')::time;
  wkends  boolean := (ava.setting('quiet_weekends') #>> '{}')::boolean;
  l       timestamp := ts AT TIME ZONE tz;
  dow     int := extract(isodow FROM l);
BEGIN
  IF wkends AND (dow IN (6,7) OR (dow = 5 AND l::time >= q_start) OR (dow = 1 AND l::time < q_end)) THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;
  RETURN l::time >= q_start OR l::time < q_end;
END $$;

-- Next moment quiet hours end (now, if not quiet)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION quiet_ends_at(ts timestamptz DEFAULT now()) RETURNS timestamptz
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
  t timestamptz := ts;
BEGIN
  -- step forward in 15-minute increments until active (max ~4 days)
  FOR i IN 1..400 LOOP
    EXIT WHEN NOT ava.is_quiet(t);
    t := date_trunc('hour', t) + interval '15 min' * (floor(extract(minute FROM t) / 15) + 1);
  END LOOP;
  RETURN t;
END $$;

-- Add N "active" minutes to a timestamp, skipping quiet hours (timers pause)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_active_minutes(start_ts timestamptz, minutes int) RETURNS timestamptz
LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$
DECLARE
  tz        text := ava.setting('timezone') #>> '{}';
  q_start   time := (ava.setting('quiet_start') #>> '{}')::time;
  t         timestamptz := ava.quiet_ends_at(start_ts);
  remaining interval := make_interval(mins => minutes);
  win_end   timestamptz;
  avail     interval;
BEGIN
  LOOP
    -- active window closes at today's quiet_start (local)
    win_end := ((t AT TIME ZONE tz)::date + q_start) AT TIME ZONE tz;
    avail   := win_end - t;
    IF remaining <= avail THEN
      RETURN t + remaining;
    END IF;
    remaining := remaining - avail;
    t := ava.quiet_ends_at(win_end);
  END LOOP;
END $$;

-- Senders currently blocked (N spam events in D days, rescued ones excluded)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW blocked_senders AS
SELECT channel, identifier, count(*) AS spam_count, max(created_at) AS last_spam_at
FROM ava.spam_events
WHERE action <> 'not_spam'
  AND created_at > now() - make_interval(days => (ava.setting('spam_block')->>'days')::int)
GROUP BY channel, identifier
HAVING count(*) >= (ava.setting('spam_block')->>'count')::int;

-- Keep updated_at fresh
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION touch_updated_at() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END $$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS clients_touch  ON clients;
CREATE TRIGGER clients_touch  BEFORE UPDATE ON clients  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at();
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS bookings_touch ON bookings;
CREATE TRIGGER bookings_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON bookings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at();
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS settings_touch ON settings;
CREATE TRIGGER settings_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON settings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION touch_updated_at();

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'ava' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE') AS tables,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ava.settings) AS settings_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ava.services) AS services_rows,
  ava.is_quiet(now()) AS quiet_now,
  (ava.add_active_minutes(now(), 120) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::text AS standard_checkpoint_if_requested_now

## Ava DB Setup
Run manually to create or upgrade the `ava` schema. Safe to re-run: every statement is idempotent. Settings and services are only inserted if missing, so edits made in the database are kept.

parameters.query:
-- =====================================================================
-- v1.6 - Scheduler sweep: approval timers, expiry, reminders, cleanup
-- Every step claims its rows with an UPDATE ... RETURNING, so two sweeps
-- running at once can never send the same message twice.
-- =====================================================================
SET search_path TO ava, public;

-- Where to reach a client on a channel (email replies need the latest inbound message id)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION client_reply_target(p_client uuid, p_channel text) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'recipient', COALESCE(
      (SELECT identifier FROM ava.client_identifiers WHERE client_id = p_client AND channel = p_channel
        ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), ''),
    'reply_to', COALESCE(
      (SELECT external_id FROM ava.messages WHERE client_id = p_client AND channel = p_channel AND direction = 'in'
        ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), ''),
    'thread_ref', COALESCE(
      (SELECT thread_ref FROM ava.messages WHERE client_id = p_client AND channel = p_channel AND direction = 'in'
        ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), ''))
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION client_message(p_client uuid, p_channel text, p_text text) RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('client_id', p_client, 'channel', p_channel, 'text', p_text, 'author', 'ava')
         || ava.client_reply_target(p_client, p_channel)
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sweep() RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE
  v_owner   text := ava.setting('owner_name') #>> '{}';
  v_gap     interval := make_interval(hours => COALESCE((ava.setting('conversation_gap_hours') #>> '{}')::int, 12));
  v_msgs    jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_ids     uuid[];
  v_count   jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  b         record;
  v_first   text;
  v_how     text;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Approval checkpoint: nudge the owner (with buttons) and tell the client we are still waiting
  WITH u AS (
    UPDATE ava.bookings SET checkpoint_sent_at = now()
     WHERE status = 'pending' AND checkpoint_sent_at IS NULL AND checkpoint_due_at <= now() AND expires_at > now()
    RETURNING id)
  SELECT array_agg(id) INTO v_ids FROM u;
  v_count := v_count || jsonb_build_object('checkpoints', COALESCE(array_length(v_ids, 1), 0));

  FOR b IN SELECT bk.*, c.name AS client_name, s.name AS service FROM ava.bookings bk
             JOIN ava.clients c ON c.id = bk.client_id LEFT JOIN ava.services s ON s.id = bk.service_id
            WHERE bk.id = ANY(COALESCE(v_ids, '{}')) LOOP
    v_first := COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(b.client_name, ' ', 1), ''), 'there');
    PERFORM ava.queue_owner_alert('reminder', b.urgent,
      '⏰ Still waiting on your approval' || CASE WHEN b.urgent THEN ' (urgent)' ELSE '' END || E'\n\n'
      || COALESCE(b.client_name, 'Client') || ': ' || COALESCE(b.service, 'call') || ', ' || ava.fmt_local(b.start_at) || E' ET\n'
      || 'Expires ' || ava.fmt_local(b.expires_at) || ' ET if not answered.',
      '[{"text":"✅ Approve","action":"approve"},{"text":"❌ Decline","action":"decline"}]'::jsonb, b.id);
    v_msgs := v_msgs || ava.client_message(b.client_id, b.channel,
      'Quick update, ' || v_first || ': ' || v_owner || ' hasn''t confirmed your ' || COALESCE(b.service, 'call')
      || ' request for ' || ava.fmt_local(b.start_at) || ' ET yet. You''ll hear back soon.');
  END LOOP;

  -- 2. Expiry: the request lapses, the client is offered other times, the owner is told
  WITH u AS (
    UPDATE ava.bookings SET status = 'expired', decided_at = now()
     WHERE status = 'pending' AND expires_at <= now()
    RETURNING id)
  SELECT array_agg(id) INTO v_ids FROM u;
  v_count := v_count || jsonb_build_object('expired', COALESCE(array_length(v_ids, 1), 0));

  FOR b IN SELECT bk.*, c.name AS client_name, s.name AS service, o.start_at AS original_start
             FROM ava.bookings bk
             JOIN ava.clients c ON c.id = bk.client_id LEFT JOIN ava.services s ON s.id = bk.service_id
             LEFT JOIN ava.bookings o ON o.id = bk.replaces_booking_id
            WHERE bk.id = ANY(COALESCE(v_ids, '{}')) LOOP
    v_first := COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(b.client_name, ' ', 1), ''), 'there');
    PERFORM ava.queue_owner_alert('expiry', b.urgent,
      '⌛ Request expired with no answer' || E'\n\n' || COALESCE(b.client_name, 'Client') || ': '
      || COALESCE(b.service, 'call') || ', ' || ava.fmt_local(b.start_at) || E' ET\n'
      || 'The client was offered other times.', NULL, b.id);
    v_msgs := v_msgs || ava.client_message(b.client_id, b.channel,
      CASE WHEN b.kind = 'reschedule' AND b.original_start IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Sorry, ' || v_first || ': ' || v_owner || ' wasn''t able to confirm the move to ' || ava.fmt_local(b.start_at)
             || ' ET in time, so your original time (' || ava.fmt_local(b.original_start) || ' ET) still stands. Want me to look for another option?'
        ELSE 'Sorry, ' || v_first || ': ' || v_owner || ' wasn''t able to confirm ' || ava.fmt_local(b.start_at)
             || ' ET in time, so that request has lapsed. Would you like me to find another time?' END);
  END LOOP;

  -- 3. Reminders before confirmed calls (skipped silently if the call was booked inside the window)
  WITH u AS (
    UPDATE ava.bookings SET reminder_24h_sent_at = now()
     WHERE status = 'approved' AND reminder_24h_sent_at IS NULL
       AND start_at > now() AND start_at - now() <= interval '24 hours'
    RETURNING id, ((decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at > start_at - interval '24 hours')
                   OR start_at - now() < interval '2 hours') AS skip)
  SELECT array_agg(id) FILTER (WHERE NOT skip) INTO v_ids FROM u;
  v_count := v_count || jsonb_build_object('reminders_24h', COALESCE(array_length(v_ids, 1), 0));

  FOR b IN SELECT bk.*, c.name AS client_name, s.name AS service FROM ava.bookings bk
             JOIN ava.clients c ON c.id = bk.client_id LEFT JOIN ava.services s ON s.id = bk.service_id
            WHERE bk.id = ANY(COALESCE(v_ids, '{}')) LOOP
    v_first := COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(b.client_name, ' ', 1), ''), 'there');
    v_how := CASE WHEN b.call_format = 'phone'
      THEN v_owner || ' will call you at ' || COALESCE(b.call_phone, 'the number you gave') || '. If that number has changed, just reply with the new one.'
      ELSE COALESCE('Join on Google Meet: ' || b.meet_link, 'The Google Meet link is in your calendar invite.') END;
    v_msgs := v_msgs || ava.client_message(b.client_id, b.channel,
      'Hi ' || v_first || ', a reminder that your ' || COALESCE(b.service, 'call') || ' with ' || v_owner
      || CASE WHEN (b.start_at AT TIME ZONE (ava.setting('timezone') #>> '{}'))::date
                   = (now() AT TIME ZONE (ava.setting('timezone') #>> '{}'))::date
              THEN ' is today, ' ELSE ' is tomorrow, ' END
      || ava.fmt_local(b.start_at) || E' ET.\n\n' || v_how
      || E'\n\nReply here if you can''t make it.');
  END LOOP;

  WITH u AS (
    UPDATE ava.bookings SET reminder_1h_sent_at = now()
     WHERE status = 'approved' AND reminder_1h_sent_at IS NULL
       AND start_at > now() AND start_at - now() <= interval '60 minutes'
    RETURNING id, (decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at > start_at - interval '60 minutes') AS skip)
  SELECT array_agg(id) FILTER (WHERE NOT skip) INTO v_ids FROM u;
  v_count := v_count || jsonb_build_object('reminders_1h', COALESCE(array_length(v_ids, 1), 0));

  FOR b IN SELECT bk.*, c.name AS client_name, s.name AS service FROM ava.bookings bk
             JOIN ava.clients c ON c.id = bk.client_id LEFT JOIN ava.services s ON s.id = bk.service_id
            WHERE bk.id = ANY(COALESCE(v_ids, '{}')) LOOP
    v_first := COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(b.client_name, ' ', 1), ''), 'there');
    v_how := CASE WHEN b.call_format = 'phone'
      THEN v_owner || ' will call you at ' || COALESCE(b.call_phone, 'the number you gave') || '.'
      ELSE COALESCE('Join here: ' || b.meet_link, 'The Google Meet link is in your calendar invite.') END;
    v_msgs := v_msgs || ava.client_message(b.client_id, b.channel,
      'Hi ' || v_first || ', your ' || COALESCE(b.service, 'call') || ' with ' || v_owner || ' starts in about an hour ('
      || trim(to_char(b.start_at AT TIME ZONE (ava.setting('timezone') #>> '{}'), 'FMHH12:MI AM')) || E' ET).\n\n' || v_how);
  END LOOP;

  -- 4. Calls that have ended
  WITH u AS (UPDATE ava.bookings SET status = 'completed' WHERE status = 'approved' AND end_at < now() RETURNING id)
  SELECT array_agg(id) INTO v_ids FROM u;
  v_count := v_count || jsonb_build_object('completed', COALESCE(array_length(v_ids, 1), 0));

  -- 5. Close conversations that have gone quiet (summaries are written by the workflow)
  UPDATE ava.conversations
     SET status = 'closed', closed_at = last_message_at + v_gap, close_reason = 'inactive'
   WHERE status = 'open' AND last_message_at < now() - v_gap;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'counts', v_count,
    'client_messages', v_msgs,
    'summarize', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(conversation_id) FROM ava.conversations_needing_summary(NULL, 10)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'alerts_due', (SELECT count(*) FROM ava.owner_alerts WHERE status = 'queued' AND deliver_after <= now())
  );
END $$;

-- =====================================================================
-- v1.8 - Approval alerts wait until the client has been told
-- Approval alerts are created 'held'. The Core Router releases them only
-- after Ava's reply to the client is delivered. A safety net in the sweep
-- releases any hold older than 2 minutes so an approval is never lost.
-- =====================================================================
SET search_path TO ava, public;

ALTER TABLE owner_alerts DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS owner_alerts_status_check;
ALTER TABLE owner_alerts ADD CONSTRAINT owner_alerts_status_check
  CHECK (status IN ('held', 'queued', 'sent', 'failed', 'void'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION hold_approval_alerts() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.kind = 'approval' THEN
    NEW.status := 'held';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS owner_alerts_hold_approvals ON owner_alerts;
CREATE TRIGGER owner_alerts_hold_approvals BEFORE INSERT ON owner_alerts
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION hold_approval_alerts();

-- Called by the Core Router after the client reply is delivered
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION release_held_alerts(p_client uuid) RETURNS int
LANGUAGE sql AS $$
  WITH u AS (
    UPDATE ava.owner_alerts a SET status = 'queued'
      FROM ava.bookings b
     WHERE a.booking_id = b.id AND b.client_id = p_client AND a.status = 'held'
    RETURNING a.id)
  SELECT count(*)::int FROM u
$$;

-- Safety net used by the scheduler sweep
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION release_stale_holds() RETURNS int
LANGUAGE sql AS $$
  WITH u AS (
    UPDATE ava.owner_alerts SET status = 'queued'
     WHERE status = 'held' AND created_at < now() - interval '2 minutes'
    RETURNING id)
  SELECT count(*)::int FROM u
$$;
